decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed side and rear extension, by way of its positioning, size, scale, design and appearance, would respect the character of the dwelling and those that surround it and would not harm neighbours' living conditions and is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant no undue adverse effects would result.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the sidewalls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.
description: The erection of a two storey side and part two storey, part single storey rear extension.
